name: onedrive
description: Search, create, edit, review, share, and recover OneDrive files with preview-and-confirm safeguards.

interface.shortDescription: Search, edit, review, share, and recover OneDrive files safely.
interface.longDescription: Use Microsoft OneDrive in ChatGPT Work to search and open files; discover enterprise document libraries; create folders; upload, update, rename, copy, and move content; inspect, render, review, and edit Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files; export PDF or text; manage links and permissions; and recover recycle-bin deletions. Consequential writes and sharing actions use preview-and-confirm safeguards plus post-action verification. Every user signs in with OAuth, and credentials, resources, caches, and indexes stay isolated by account and drive.
defaultPrompt: Find the enterprise document libraries I can access in OneDrive.
Inspect and safely edit a Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file in OneDrive.
